cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've made your favourite cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Bring your concert friend too. I'll reimburse both tickets in cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She only went because I promised her dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear the living room. You can choose the music; I'd just like to be in the room with you.

mechanism: A sells attendance at A birthday over a concert by treating evening planning as a professional discipline and correcting the rival plan constraints.
confusable: Ordinary pleading or bribery lacks precise corrective expertise used to make A the better choice.
comparison: Photographer alternative competes for a working role rather than personal birthday attention.
seedUse: Birthday seed supplies paid tickets and promised dancing; S03 should correct the proposed replacement dance setup rather than simply offer music choice.
